responsibility: This file implements mc’s module search-path and source resolution logic. It maintains initial and user-prepended colon-separated search paths, constructs candidate .def and .mod filenames via mcFileName, probes filesystem existence, and returns full paths for requested source files or module stems. It is the file-discovery backend used by mcOptions for -I handling and by mcComp when opening imported or companion modules.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation of the mcSearch interface, maintaining InitialPath/UserPath state, using mcFileName.calculateFileName, and calling SFIO.Exists during lookups; mcSearch.def only declares those services.
